status: frozen before any analyst-scenario data exist; calibration plugs numbers into `mapping`, nothing else changes
law: x_i(t) = sum_j W_ij sigma_j(t) + a0 h0_i + nu xi_i(t+1) + c + kappa sigma_i(t); s_i(t+1) = tanh x_i(t); sigma_i(t+1) = +-1 with P(+1) = (1 + s_i(t+1))/2; W_ij = +a_plus/K (ally), -a_minus/K (faded)

mapping.Lam_mutual: (K-1) [tanh^2(b a_plus/K) + tanh^2(b a_minus/K)] / 2 with b = (1 + pi nu^2 / 2)^(-1/2) (a0 = 0, kappa = 0); standing notes lower it (reference design: boundary at rms gain 5.9 instead of 5.0, part G); memory multiplies Lam(0) by (1 + c1)^2 and Lam(pi) by (1 - c1)^2; otherwise analyst_lib.dmft(P, 'mutual', copies=64)['Lam'] below the boundary and the long simulation of part G near it
mapping.Lam_antagonistic: equal to Lam_mutual, at omega = pi/2, when a_minus = a_plus and a0 = 0; otherwise analyst_lib.dmft
mapping.response_kernel: R(tau + 1) = (1 - q) rho_tau, rho_tau = sum zeta_i(t) s_i(t + tau) / sum zeta_i(t)^2, zeta = sigma - s
mapping.echo: rho_2 = Gamma <d_i d_j> to leading order; exact value from analyst_lib.dmft(...)['rho'][1] (K = inf) or check_analyst.sim_runs (K = 16 graph)
mapping.every_number: analyst_lib.dmft(Agent(...), world) and check_analyst.sim_runs(Agent(...), world, N, T, R, graphs) with the calibrated Agent; the tables below are these functions on a grid

boundary.rms_gain: sqrt((a_plus^2 + a_minus^2) / 2), half log-odds per unit normalized field

index.A: closure: solver against graphs at N = 256, 1024, 4096 and K = 64; transient m(t), q(t); kurtosis
index.B: stability: exact mutual-world results, tree check, Lam(omega) table, news, antagonistic ratio, herding
index.C: signatures: keys '<schedule>|<intensity>|<world>' with rho, c, S, X2, tau, A, q, D; N dependence; leak
index.D: kick twins: keys '<intensity>|<world>' with rA, rD, E, linear values, noise per twin, twins for 3 s.e.
index.E: sizing: keys '<intensity>|N<N>|<world>', each statistic as [mean, run-to-run s.d.] at T = 20
index.G: long simulations: amplification and long-lag correlations against gain; boundary location
